description: This PHP class 'FilterUsingXForwardedHeaders' modifies HTTP request URIs based on trusted X-Forwarded-* headers, primarily used for proxy-aware request handling in server environments.

classes.name: FilterUsingXForwardedHeaders
classes.description: Final class implementing request filtering based on X-Forwarded headers, with methods to trust proxies and handle header validation.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Modifies the request URI based on trusted headers if the request originates from a trusted proxy.

methods.name: trustProxies
methods.description: Creates an instance trusting specific proxy CIDR ranges and headers.

methods.name: trustAny
methods.description: Creates an instance trusting any proxy, suitable for behind a trusted reverse proxy.

methods.name: trustReservedSubnets
methods.description: Creates an instance trusting headers from common private and reserved subnets.

methods.name: isFromTrustedProxy
methods.description: Checks if a remote address matches trusted proxy ranges.

methods.name: validateTrustedHeaders
methods.description: Validates that provided headers are among the recognized trusted headers.

methods.name: normalizeProxiesList
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a list of proxy CIDR ranges, handling wildcards.

methods.name: validateProxyCIDR
methods.description: Validates a CIDR notation string for IP address ranges.
